segments.name: Nebius
products: advanced tools for AI model training
segments.description: Runs a full-stack AI cloud for enterprises, AI companies and developers, from GPU compute and storage to managed services and training tools.
segments.evidence: This combination of AI-optimized hardware and software enables us to deliver high-performance GPU compute clusters, storage, managed services, and advanced tools for AI model training, application building and deployment, and inference at enterprise-scale.

segments.name: Avride
segments.description: Develops autonomous driving technology for self-driving vehicles and delivery robotics, contributing only a limited share of group revenue.
segments.evidence: Avride, a leading developer of autonomous vehicles and delivery robots

segments.name: TripleTen
segments.description: An edtech platform that reskills individual students for careers in technology through boot camps and project-based online learning.
segments.evidence: TripleTen generates revenue from educational services to individual customers (students) through boot camps and project-based learning opportunities by providing online educational products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for on-demand or reserved AI cloud capacity, while individual students pay TripleTen for online educational products; Avride has contributed little revenue so far.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer both on-demand "pay-as-you-go" pricing and fixed "reserved capacity" contracts.

changes.text: In 2025 Toloka, previously an operating segment, was deconsolidated after Nebius ceased to hold majority voting power in it.
changes.evidence: In May 2025, following the completion of a third-party investment in Toloka, Nebius ceased to hold majority voting power in Toloka and no longer includes Toloka's results in Nebius's consolidated financial statements; we now report our stake as an equity method investment.
